about.portraitAlt: Close black-and-white portrait of MMONN in a dark suit and tie.
paragraphs: MMONN is an independent multi-genre artist and producer from Naga City. Since 2019, he has been creating music inspired by real emotions and personal experiences, blending influences from R&B, hip-hop, melodic trap, and other contemporary genres.

His notable release, “PLY4,” helped establish his presence in the local music scene. Throughout his career, MMONN has collaborated with several respected artists, including Alison Shore and Because on “Lason,” DEMI on “PLY4 Remix,” LANZETA on “Chillerong Busy,” RB Slatt on “Pagod Na,” and SXBER and Ne7in on “Kung Kakapit Ka.”

MMONN further expanded his catalog with “AMARAD,” featuring Kyleaux—a collaboration that highlights his evolving sound, emotional storytelling, and ability to create music across different styles. Driven by authenticity and artistic growth, MMONN continues to push creative boundaries, crafting music that connects with listeners through honest storytelling and versatile soundscapes.

media.copy: MMONN performed his song “PLY4” live on DBTV’s Soundtrip Episode 217, showcasing his distinct sound and stage presence to a wider Filipino audience. The performance premiered on March 21, 2024.

background.alt: MMONN performing live on DBTV’s Soundtrip, framed by hanging plants.

media.copy: MMONN was featured on Wish 107.5 with “PLY4” featuring DEMI on September 4, 2025, highlighting their collaboration and introducing the track to a wider audience.
MMONN delivered a live performance of his song “PLY4” on BAGGAZ, showcasing his distinctive sound and performance style. The video premiered on July 26, 2024.
